export.title: Print & export
export.subtitle: Choose how many labels you need. We place them on the exact Avery grid and export a print-ready PDF.
export.tip: Tip: print at 100% / actual size (no “fit to page”) and run a test on plain paper first.

welcome.title: Welcome to Gaia's Label Studio
welcome.body: Make professional soap & product labels in four easy steps. Nothing is saved online — everything lives on this computer.

onboarding.title: Let's make your first label
onboarding.subtitle: Four simple steps — everything is visual and stays on this computer.
onboarding.step1: Pick a template: choose a shape, size, and which side of the product it's for.
onboarding.step2: Add your own photo or logo, then some text — drag things right onto the label.
onboarding.step3: Use auto-layout from a recipe, or arrange it yourself with smart guides.
onboarding.step4: Print & export a ready-to-print PDF onto Avery sheets.
